name: 🐝 Spelling Bee [🐰 SPRING]
desc:
🔊 Audio must be turned on 🔊

Welcome to Spelling Bee, spell words correctly to progress through grade levels (1st - 12th)! 
Do you have what it takes to graduate?

🎁 Make sure to leave a like and join the group for a reward

This game may start off easy, but gets very difficult in later stages!
Word Count: 1000 🐝

🎃 Halloween UPDATE 
- Spooky Decorations
- Limited-Time Items from the Headless Horseman
- Halloween-Themed Words
- Bug Fixes

**Game was designed for my friend, @Faitent, she's terrible at spelling!
